intro: Week 2 is final and Week 3 kicks off tonight. Two teams are still perfect, two are still winless, and four of the five Week 2 losers had a winning lineup sitting on their bench.

blurbs.10: Perfect 18-0 in all-play and the most points in the league. They've already beaten the #2 and #3 teams. Nobody else is close.
blurbs.9: Josh Allen dropped 46.82, the biggest individual game of the week. Still left 39.3 points on the bench, most in the league, with Kelce's 25.1 sitting behind Goedert's 1.4.
blurbs.5: Put up 151.88, the second-best score of the week, and still lost. Dak's 37.76 on the bench would have won it.
blurbs.7: Goff went for 37.78 and it wasn't enough against the Allen show. Fourth in points and 11-7 in all-play, which is solid.
blurbs.4: Won Week 2 by 0.26 and has faced the fourth-most points against (255.82). Bryce Young's 30.08 sat behind Bo Nix's 16.12, so there's more in this roster than the scoreboard shows.
blurbs.8: 2-0 despite ranking eighth in points for. A 4-14 all-play mark and the lowest points against in the league (176.7) say the schedule has been kind. Next up: the team that's 18-0 in all-play.
blurbs.3: Went from 142.16 in Week 1 to 86.5 in Week 2, the lowest score of the week. Biggest faller.
blurbs.2: Won with 93.44, a score that would have lost to any team except the one they drew. CeeDee carried with 31.3 while Nabers gave you 0.6. A 3-15 all-play record means there's no margin for error.
blurbs.6: 0-2, but 213.54 points is more than 1-1 Mayo Clinic and 2-0 The real Mr Ez. DJ Moore started and put up -0.1 in a 5.9-point loss. That's a rough way to go 0-2.
blurbs.1: 0-2 and last in points for (188.68). Lost Week 2 by 0.26 with Tre Tucker's 20.4 on the bench. Same 4-14 all-play record as the 2-0 real Mr Ez, which tells you how much luck is in these standings.

recap.1: Lamb outscored everybody on the field. Facilitator started Mumpfield (1.7), Montgomery (3.4) and Strange (3.7) while Andrews (10.9) and Adonai Mitchell (9.3) sat. Their best possible lineup was 106.8, which wins it.
recap.2: Decided by 0.26 points. EZ-Bee-Z started Alec Pierce (1.6) and left Tre Tucker (20.4) on the bench. That's the game.
recap.3: Allen beat Goff by 9 in the QB duel, and Cook and Henry combined for 36.6 to 23.6 from Tuten and Swift. That was the whole margin.
recap.4: Stafford did the heavy lifting. Starting Jalen Coker (10.6) over DJ Moore (-0.1) flips this one to the Meatsticks.
recap.5: Game of the week. JSN and Mahomes (34.98) edged out Purdy, St. Brown (30.7) and a surprise 26 from Dalton Schultz. Dak's 37.76 sat on the Butter Boys bench.

preview.3: A coin flip on paper. Saquon, Mike Evans, Brock Bowers and Jalen Coker are all questionable, so the injury report probably decides this one.
preview.4: Purdy vs Goff after both went for 30-plus last week. The Butter Boys have scored the third-most points and are due a little luck.
preview.2: Mayo is rolling with Malik Willis at QB and a questionable Nabers. They need CeeDee to go nuclear again.
preview.1: A bounce-back spot for Lamar and the Facilitator. EZ-Bee-Z (the 0-2 one) has the lowest projection of the week, so check that bench before kickoff.
preview.5: The 2-0 real Mr Ez (DrewLan13, not to be confused with 0-2 EZ-Bee-Z) runs into the league's best team with three questionable starters. The lucky start gets its first real test.
